# Third-party notices

<!-- GENERATED by `xenolith-dev notices` (dev:V347) from `cargo metadata`, the
vendored grammars' UPSTREAM records and the nix package's tool table. Edit
dev/src/notices.rs, never this file: `xenolith-dev notices --check` is a gate
step, and a hand edit is the drift it reports. -->

`xnl` carries three kinds of other people's work: Rust crates compiled into
the binary, tree-sitter grammars vendored as C source, and -- in the nix
package only -- the linters it runs. Each is listed below with the licence
its owner declares. Nothing here is typed by hand: the file is regenerated
from those three sources, and the gate fails when it drifts from them.

## Crates compiled into `xnl`

**35 third-party crates** are in the normal-dependency closure of the
published crates -- `xenolith` and its language crates, every `lang-*`
feature on. Dev-dependencies are excluded: they are not distributed in
anything you run. So is `xenolith-dev`, which is never published.

| licence | crates |
|---|---|
| `MIT OR Apache-2.0` | 22 |
| `MIT` | 7 |
| `Apache-2.0 OR MIT` | 2 |
| `Unlicense OR MIT` | 2 |
| `(MIT OR Apache-2.0) AND Unicode-3.0` | 1 |
| `Apache-2.0/MIT` | 1 |

Where an expression offers a choice, `xenolith` is distributed under MIT
and takes the MIT option.

**An `AND` is not a choice.** Every part of an expression joined by `AND`
applies, whichever option is taken for the rest: `unicode-ident`.

Proc-macro crates (`serde_derive`) run inside the compiler and put no code of their
own in the binary. They are listed because cargo resolves them as
normal dependencies all the same.

## Build-time only

grammars -- and none of their code is in `xnl`.

| crate | version | licence |

| `find-msvc-tools` | 0.1.13 | `MIT OR Apache-2.0` |

## Vendored tree-sitter grammars

**3 grammars** are compiled from C vendored beside the crate that uses
them (`languages:V121`), because none is on crates.io in a form this
workspace can link. Each directory keeps upstream's licence file verbatim
and an `UPSTREAM` record of where it came from and what, if anything, was
patched.

### `tree-sitter-just`

- vendored in [`languages/ci/just/vendor/tree-sitter-just`](../languages/ci/just/vendor/tree-sitter-just/UPSTREAM)
- upstream: <https://github.com/casey/tree-sitter-just> at `5685543a6e64f66335e25518c9ae8ffa1dae3d01`
- licence: MIT per the crate manifest and package.json; the repo's LICENSE file at the rev above is Apache-2.0 text, kept verbatim beside this file as LICENSE.txt. Both are allowed by deny.toml.
- [`LICENSE.txt`](../languages/ci/just/vendor/tree-sitter-just/LICENSE.txt), verbatim

### `tree-sitter-pkl`

- vendored in [`languages/ci/pkl/vendor/tree-sitter-pkl`](../languages/ci/pkl/vendor/tree-sitter-pkl/UPSTREAM)
- upstream: <https://github.com/apple/tree-sitter-pkl> at `5893fb5dc832ea51a9bff3f84462528c766ecd7d`
- licence: Apache-2.0 (LICENSE.txt, NOTICE.txt beside this file, verbatim)
- [`LICENSE.txt`](../languages/ci/pkl/vendor/tree-sitter-pkl/LICENSE.txt), verbatim
- [`NOTICE.txt`](../languages/ci/pkl/vendor/tree-sitter-pkl/NOTICE.txt), verbatim

The `NOTICE.txt` upstream ships with it, reproduced as its licence
asks:

```text
Copyright © 2024 Apple Inc. and the Pkl project authors

The tree-sitter-pkl binary includes libraries that may be distributed under a different license.
```

### `tree-sitter-tcl`

- vendored in [`languages/shells/tcl/vendor/tree-sitter-tcl`](../languages/shells/tcl/vendor/tree-sitter-tcl/UPSTREAM)
- upstream: <https://github.com/tree-sitter-grammars/tree-sitter-tcl> at `850a72ab6436e06645b33b11cfa60cbdb04b1f01`
- licence: MIT (LICENSE beside this file, verbatim)
- [`LICENSE`](../languages/shells/tcl/vendor/tree-sitter-tcl/LICENSE), verbatim

## Tools the nix package runs

`packages.default` wraps `xnl` with the linters of its compiled-in
languages on `PATH` (`nix:V96`). They are separate programs `xnl` runs,
never linked into it -- aggregation, not a derived work -- and each keeps
its own licence. A cargo build ships none of them.

| command | nixpkgs package | version | licence |
|---|---|---|---|
| `checkbashisms` | checkbashisms | 2.25.10 | `GPL-2.0-or-later` |
| `deadnix` | deadnix | 1.3.2 | `GPL-3.0-only` |
| `just` | just | 1.51.0 | `CC0-1.0` |
| `nixfmt` | nixfmt | 1.5.0 | `MPL-2.0` |
| `shellcheck` | ShellCheck | 0.11.0 | `GPL-3.0-only` |
| `shfmt` | shfmt | 3.13.1 | `BSD-3-Clause` |
| `statix` | statix | 0-unstable-2026-05-14 | `MIT` |
| `xenolith-tcl-syntax` | xenolith-tcl-syntax | 0.1.0 | `MIT` |
| `xmllint` | libxml2 | 2.15.4 | `MIT` |
| `zsh` | zsh | 5.9.1 | `MIT-Modern-Variant` |
